map.常用宏平均(各类指标等权平均，看重小类)或微平均(汇总所有 TP/FP/FN，等: Commonly use macro averaging (equal weight per class, which favours small classes) or micro averaging (pooling all TP/FP/FN, equivalent to overall accuracy), chosen according to how sensitive the business is to small classes.
map.由混淆矩阵四类计数推导：准确率衡量整体判对比例，精确率关注\"报为正的有多少真\: Derived from the four confusion-matrix counts: accuracy measures the overall proportion correct, precision focuses on "how many reported positives are real", recall focuses on "how many true positives are found", and F1 is the harmonic mean of the two. When the samples are extremely imbalanced accuracy becomes misleading and you should look at F1 or the area under the PR curve instead.
